architecture_summary: React SPA with Vite. Frontend: src/ structure. Backend: separate NestJS service (tickets later). State: React Context + localStorage for cart. Routing: React Router v6. Styling: TailwindCSS. No SSR. Ponytail: auth flow stubbed, real auth later. DB schema tickets follow after frontend DAG.

tickets.title: Scaffold App.jsx navigation
tickets.description: Create App.jsx. Set up React Router. Define routes: / (Home), /catalog, /order. Add TailwindCSS base styles. Ponytail: auth routes stubbed, add when backend ready.

tickets.title: Build Home screen
tickets.description: Create Home.jsx. Hero banner with call-to-action. Featured items grid (mock data). Search bar. Ponytail: search logic stubbed, connect to API later.
acceptance_criteria: Hero banner renders with CTA button
Featured items grid displays 4 mock items
Search bar present, input field functional

tickets.title: Build Catalog screen

acceptance_criteria: Product grid displays mock items (12 per page)

tickets.title: Build Order form screen
tickets.description: Create Order.jsx. Multi-step form: cart review, shipping details, payment. Form validation. Ponytail: payment gateway stubbed, real integration later.
acceptance_criteria: Payment form stub renders (credit card fields)

tickets.title: Implement cart state management
tickets.description: Create CartContext.jsx. Add/remove/update items. Persist to localStorage. Ponytail: sync with backend later.
